Lernen or Unterrichten? German A2 Learning and Teaching

Compare lernen for acquiring knowledge and unterrichten for teaching a class. Practise German learner and teacher roles with translated examples and answers.

A2 level4 worked examples4 practice questions

Independent practice by Klarweg. Not an official Goethe exam or assessment.

Understand the difference

Lernen means learning material or acquiring a skill; unterrichten means teaching or giving instruction. The same person can do both at different times, so a job title alone does not decide the verb. Learn the activity and role in the particular sentence: Deutsch lernen, eine Klasse unterrichten.

Common mistake to avoid

English learn and teach are separate here: Ich lerne Deutsch describes my learning; Ich unterrichte Deutsch describes my teaching.

How to practise: read the examples once, cover the English meanings and try explaining the choice aloud. Next, complete all four questions before opening their answers.

Four German examples with English meanings

Pay attention to the exact article, verb position or ending described in the rule.

Worked example 1Die Kinder lernen heute die Namen der Monate.The children are learning the names of the months today.
Worked example 2Die Lehrerin unterrichtet heute eine neue Klasse.The teacher is teaching a new class today.
Worked example 3Ich lerne gerade, wie man Brot backt.I am currently learning how to bake bread.
Worked example 4Er unterrichtet Musik an einer kleinen Schule.He teaches music at a small school.

Practice: choose the right word

Choose lernen for acquiring the specified knowledge or unterrichten for teaching it to a class. Conjugate the verb where needed. Try each question before opening the answer. A dash (—) means no word is needed. Where another answer is possible, the explanation notes it. These are self-check exercises, not exam scoring.

Question 1. Ich ___ gerade neue Wörter aus dem Text. (learn)

Show answer and explanation for question 1

Answer: lerne

Lerne describes acquiring the new vocabulary.

Question 2. Ich ___ eine Gruppe von zwölf Anfängern. (teach)

Show answer and explanation for question 2

Answer: unterrichte

Unterrichte describes giving instruction to the group.

Question 3. Wir möchten das Lied erst ___. (learn it ourselves)

Show answer and explanation for question 3

Answer: lernen

The group is acquiring the song, not teaching it.

Question 4. Sie möchte später Mathematik ___. (teach the subject)

Show answer and explanation for question 4

Answer: unterrichten

Unterrichten describes the intended teaching activity.

Revise it so it sticks

Return to this lesson tomorrow and complete the four gaps without looking at the rule. Then write two of your own sentences using today's pattern. Check whether the subject, case and verb position match the explanation.
